content: Glacial Milk is a brand of liquid nutritional supplements developed by Innovative Technologies Corporation of America. This brand offers a range of bottled products, including the following: Complete Nutrition NONI Complete Coral Calcium Plus JOINT FORMULA Plus Hair of the Dog CARB CRUSHER The company actively participates in Sam's Club roadshows, where they provide samples of these liquid supplements to store customers. During these events, customers are also given the opportunity to purchase these products directly in the store. It is important to note that these products have not undergone evaluation or approval by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
